sources.title: ComfyUI-MOSS-Image-Ostris-Edit - GitHub
sources.snippet: Nodes for running MOSS-Image edit LoRAs trained with ai-toolkit (the MOSS-Image Base [Edit Training] / MOSS-Image SFT [Edit Training] models, i.e. the moss_image arch with model_kwargs.edit: true).

sources.title: Moss-Image-Edit by chinoll lands on Hugging Face - AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: A Reddit user asks whether anyone has tried Moss-Image-Edit, a newly released image editing model by chinoll, on Kromoss, linking to the Hugging Face repo. A fresh resource worth a look for those following open-source image editing.

sources.title: MOSS-Image/comfyui at main · OpenMOSS/MOSS-Image · GitHub
sources.snippet: In MOSS-Image HF Loader, set model_path to the downloaded local directory containing transformer/, text_encoder/, tokenizer/, and vae/. Edit the positive and negative prompts, then click Run to generate an image.

sources.title: MOSS-Image Edit LoRA Adds Instruction Editing to ComfyUI
sources.snippet: A rank-64 edit LoRA gives MOSS-Image instruction-based editing with one to four references, and ComfyUI core merged native edit-LoRA support the same day.
